hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#2D2D2D]
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#2D2D2D]

layout_and_spacing.grid_standard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 md:gap-12

header.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#FAF6EC]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5DFD3]/50

buttons.primary: bg-[#C5A059] text-white hover:bg-[#B38F48] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium tracking-wide

cards.style: Flat Solid with sharp edges (Neumorphism twist)
cards.classes: bg-white border border-[#E5DFD3] p-8 hover:-translate-y-2 transition-transform duration-300 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl

sections_instructions.hero: Full bleed hero image with a soft gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/50 via-black/30 to-transparent) to ensure text readability. White text for high contrast. Left-aligned content. `data-testid='hero-section'`
sections_instructions.about: Asymmetrical layout. Image on left spanning 5 cols, content on right spanning 7 cols. Use the abstract texture background. `data-testid='about-section'`
sections_instructions.services: Grid of 8 minimalist cards. Include lucide-react or phosphore icons (thin stroke). `data-testid='services-grid'`
sections_instructions.portfolio: Masonry or tight grid. Category filters (Budget, Mid-Range, Premium) above the grid. Image hover effect: subtle zoom within container. `data-testid='portfolio-gallery'`
sections_instructions.why_choose_us: Alternating bento grid layout with 1px gold borders. Use deep charcoal (#2D2D2D) surface for one of the highlight blocks for contrast. `data-testid='why-choose-us'`
sections_instructions.pricing: 3 tiers. Standard in the middle slightly elevated. Background ivory, middle card white with gold border. `data-testid='pricing-section'`
sections_instructions.testimonials: Carousel or Grid using Embla Carousel or basic flex overflow. Elegant quote styling. `data-testid='testimonials-section'`
sections_instructions.contact: Clean Shadcn form customized with square inputs, ivory background, gold focus rings. `data-testid='contact-form'`
sections_instructions.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right button, green branding (#25D366) or minimal gold depending on contrast. `data-testid='whatsapp-float'`
sections_instructions.footer: Dark charcoal background (#2D2D2D) with ivory and gold text for a premium end. `data-testid='footer'`

animation_guidelines.hover_states: Smooth transitions on all interactive elements (duration-300).
animation_guidelines.entrance: Use framer-motion for elegant fade-up animations on scroll (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
